name: Capsule Speaker
description: A horizontal capsule speaker wrapped in tightly woven chartreuse fabric, soft-touch graphite silicone end caps each holding a round passive radiator, a graphite nylon webbing carry strap looped from one end cap through a matte gunmetal ring, and four small graphite rubber buttons along the top; OSSETT HUME printed large in graphite capitals across the front of the fabric, about half the body length.
dimensions: about 19 cm long and 7 cm across
materials: woven recycled-polyester fabric, graphite silicone end caps, graphite nylon webbing, gunmetal ring
negativeConstraints: Never invent any text, logo, wordmark or mark beyond the ones this record names, never misspell or rearrange those, and never add a second label. No second wordmark, no metal grille, no lights.
preservationNotes: Keep the print exactly: OSSETT HUME large in graphite capitals across the front of the fabric only; the back is plain fabric with a small graphite port flap. Keep the chartreuse fabric body, the graphite end caps with passive radiators, the four top buttons and the graphite strap in every shot.
